tcs.tc_title: Left front heated seat press sends the request signal
tcs.test_item:
When the customer selects to change the state of the LF heated seat, the HU shall send an on-change $FL_HS_RQ$ = [Heated Seat Pressed / HS_PSD] signal within <Tsend>.

(Press sends the on-change request)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the left front heated seat
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator with signal tracing enabled
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start a bus trace on CAN-B that captures the frames carrying TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm
2. Press the left front heated seat icon
3. Read the CAN-B trace and check that the value sent on TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm is the one specified for the current state
tcs.expected_result:
1. The bus trace is running and is capturing the frames carrying TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm
2. The left front heated seat icon registers the press
3. PENDING: DR-15
